notes: Audited NovaFDE runtime snapshot derived from the pinned official Skill Creator. 1.1.0 adds the official description doctrine (state what the skill does plus enumerated user intents and native-language trigger keywords, deliberately pushy against under-triggering) and the three-level progressive disclosure model with the 500-line SKILL.md guideline. The local content is intentionally scoped to structured SkillIR generation and deterministic rendering; the official interactive eval/benchmark workflow is excluded because NovaFDE runs its own deterministic validation and judge loop.
